# latency-nearest-rank

行为约定：
percentile(samples, q) returns the nearest-rank percentile: sort numeric samples ascending, choose 1-based rank ceil(q * n). q is an int/float probability interpreted by its decimal spelling (so q=0.14 over 100 samples selects rank 14), and must satisfy 0 < q <= 1; empty samples and invalid q raise ValueError. Accept any finite iterable, including a one-shot generator, and do not mutate a supplied list. Samples are finite numbers.

运行：`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。
只使用运行时标准库；保持公开接口及原有断言，不安装依赖，不联网。
